title: Zanzibar in the Rainy Season
excerpt: April and May are the rainy months on Zanzibar. Is it still worth going? What to expect.
body:
## Weather

Heavy showers, often in the afternoon or at night, with sunny spells in between. High humidity.

## Closed hotels

Some hotels close in April and May.

## Advantages

- Lower prices.
- Fewer tourists.
- Green landscapes.

## Disadvantages

- Rougher sea, less visibility for snorkelling.
- Some excursions cancelled.

## November

The short rains are lighter.

See [Zanzibar weather by month](/blog/zanzibar-weather-by-month/) or [plan your trip](/travel-proposal/).
